title: Advances in methodologies of negative controls: a scoping review

evidence_strength: A-；方法综述、同行评议

project_difference: PFMval为7患者固定30通路的本地小样本验证，需独立检验联合头、对比目标与患者级泛化

title: DeepPathway: Predicting Pathway Expression from Histopathology Images
